relations.subject: V. Gordon Childe
relations.evidence: Educated at Church of England Grammar School and Sydney University.

relations.subject: V. Gordon Childe
relations.evidence: In 1914 came to England and studied at Queen’s College in Oxford. B.Litt. 1916.

relations.subject: V. Gordon Childe
relations.evidence: in 1925 became librarian of Royal Anthropological Institute.

relations.subject: V. Gordon Childe
relations.evidence: In 1927-46 Professor of Prehistoric Archaeology at Edinburgh.

relations.subject: V. Gordon Childe
relations.evidence: In 1947-56 director of the Institute of Archaeology, London, then retired and returned to Australia.
